The climb back to zero — and especially back into visibility — is a bit more challenging than expected. At the same time, asking people to vote for an account that’s about as visible as a ninja during a blackout… doesn’t exactly help. But hey, it’s fine. I’ll keep doing my thing in the shadows, like a ghost on the blockchain. And honestly, it has its perks… like being able to write absolutely anything without the risk of being contradicted — since, well, nobody’s reading anyway 😄

I could even hide secret messages for the two or three brave souls who might stumble across this by accident… but that’s not really the goal here (although, tempting).

So, what else? It’s Monday — already — and after a little unpaid break, it’s time to head back to work to refill the bank account… and, more importantly, to calm down the creditors who are starting to look at me like I’m their unpaid Netflix subscription.

That said, the break was necessary. A few personal and family issues to sort out, some cases to push forward… and when I say “push forward,” I mean going full speed ahead with the help of the legal system. Because apparently, to access “basic” rights, you sometimes have to file official complaints against public administrations. Yes, those rights that are clearly written down… but always come with a polite “sorry, you don’t meet the criteria.” The famous boxes… always the boxes.

Sometimes, I get the feeling that people who do nothing get rewarded, while those who actually try to work are the ones being held back. But anyway… I won’t get into politics, or I’ll just end up getting annoyed — and that would be a shame, especially in front of such a… nonexistent audience.

Then again, given my current level of invisibility, I could really say anything I want. 🤷‍♂️
